features.name: Custom Fields and Meta Fields Support
features.description: The Shopify connector now supports synchronization of custom fields (meta fields) defined in Shopify. Merchants can define custom fields on products or variants in Shopify admin, and the connector imports them into Business Central. Merchants can write custom extensions to map these meta fields to Business Central entities.
caveats: Connector only imports meta fields; mappings require custom extensions

features.name: Translation Synchronization
features.description: New capability to synchronize product translations across multiple languages from Business Central to Shopify. Merchants can select which languages to sync with, and item descriptions, extended text, and attributes are translated when products are added to Shopify.

features.name: Add Items as Shopify Variants
features.description: New action that allows merchants to push Business Central items to Shopify as variants of existing products. This enables combining multiple Business Central items as variants under a single Shopify product, with synchronized availability and prices.
caveats: Title control on Shopify API side is limited; full control not yet available

features.name: Customer-Specific Pricing via Catalogs
features.description: Enhancement to B2B pricing that allows linking specific Business Central customers to Shopify B2B catalogs. This enables customer-specific prices and discounts in Shopify, matching Business Central's advanced pricing capabilities for individual customers.
caveats: Field requires personalization to make visible

features.name: Community Code Contribution to Connector
features.description: A merchant and partner proactively contributed code to add customer-specific pricing functionality to the Shopify connector via GitHub. Microsoft integrated this code into the standard product, creating a win-win situation where the merchant no longer maintains separate code and Microsoft gains functionality for all connector users.

features.name: Shopify API Version Update to 2024-07
features.description: The Shopify connector now uses Shopify API version 2024-07 released in July, supported for one year. Microsoft updates the API version with each major release to align with Shopify quarterly releases and reduce breaking changes in minor updates.

features.name: Support for Up to 2000 Product Variants
features.description: The connector now supports Shopify's lifting of variant restrictions, allowing up to 2000 variants per product. This change aligns with Shopify's latest capability rollout and the connector is already prepared for this increased limit.
caveats: Currently testable only in development stores with latest Shopify version

features.name: Weight Unit Setting for Product Variants
features.description: New setting in the item synchronization tab to specify and synchronize weight units for product variants. Shopify API 2024-07 now requires weight units to be sent when syncing product weights, and Business Central automatically synchronizes this from Shopify or allows manual override.

features.name: Return Location Priority Setting
features.description: New field in return and refund processing that allows choosing between default return location and original order location for Shopify refunds. The original order location option attempts to use the return location from the Shopify refund order.
caveats: Falls back to default return location if original cannot be found

features.name: Item Charge Mapping for Shipping Charges
features.description: Enhanced shipment method mapping now supports item charges in addition to GL accounts for shipping charges. Users can map shipping charges to specific item charges like freight items, which are then distributed across sales lines.
features.status_evidence_quote: if you go to your shipment method mapping now uh instead of just one uh shipping charges type which is the GL account you

features.name: Posted Sales Invoice Synchronization
features.description: New capability to synchronize posted sales invoices to Shopify. Requires enabling posted invoice sync in order synchronization and processing tab, and configuring payment terms mapping. Synced invoices show paid or pending payment status.
caveats: Items created as custom products on Shopify to provide specific tax information

features.name: Currency Handling in Synced Invoices
features.description: Original currency from posted sales invoices is transferred to Shopify when syncing. Invoices display in their original currency on the Shopify customer portal.

features.name: Shopify Payment Integration for Invoices
features.description: Synced invoices on Shopify customer portal include a pay now button, allowing customers to pay directly using credit card information. Payment information is recorded in Shopify, making Shopify act as a payment integration.

features.name: Multi-Payment Reconciliation Capability
features.description: New capability to reconcile payments with posted invoices when orders use multiple payment methods, such as gift cards and credit cards, or partial refunds. Addresses customer reconciliation difficulties.

features.name: Suggest Shopify Payments Journal Action
features.description: New action in cash receipt journals under prepare tab called suggest Shopify payments. Allows users to select a payment gateway and pulling transactions from that gateway into journal lines. Automatically handles refunds as negative amounts and creates credit memos.
caveats: Only shows with active enabled shop

features.name: Gift Card Payment Reconciliation
features.description: Dedicated reconciliation for gift card payments through Shopify transaction page. Users can select gift card transactions and use suggest Shopify gift action to quickly reconcile gift card amounts. Works with batch tracking using transaction IDs.
